ERRORS.UNAVAILABLE: Gotchu did not confirm that. Try again in a moment.
ERRORS.UNCONFIGURED: Gotchu is not connected on this desk yet.
ERRORS.INVALID: Gotchu could not accept that. Check the highlighted fields.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This no longer exists. Reload the list.
ERRORS.CHANGED: This changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest.
ERRORS.FORBIDDEN: Only an administrator can change this.
ERRORS.DUPLICATE_SLUG: A procedure with that short name already exists for this store.
ERRORS.NOT_ACTIVE_FOR_AUTO: Only an active procedure can send on its own.

PROCEDURE.AUTO_OFF_NOT_ACTIVE: Only an active procedure can send on its own.
PROCEDURE.AUTO_OFF_UNVERIFIABLE: Auto is off here: this channel can’t prove whose order it is.
PROCEDURE.AUTO_OFF_STORE: Sending on its own is not switched on for this store.
PROCEDURE.AUTO_HINT: Sends on its own after the hold unless someone acts on the draft here or adds the gotchu-manual label. A private note or an assignment does not stop it.
PROCEDURE.KILL_LABEL: To stop it on one conversation, add the label {label}.
PROCEDURE.ADD_PHRASE: + Add a way of saying it
PROCEDURE.REMOVE_PHRASE: Remove this way of saying it
PROCEDURE.BRIEF_HINT: Write it the way you would brief a new colleague. Shop policy still applies and wins over this.
PROCEDURE.OFFER_GOODWILL: Goodwill code, after a person confirms
PROCEDURE.LAST_REPLAY: Would have answered {matched} of the last {considered} conversations.
PROCEDURE.LAST_REPLAY_AMBIGUOUS: Across all procedures, {ambiguous} were too close to call and were left alone.
PROCEDURE.SLUG_HINT: Used in links; can’t change later.

PROCEDURES.TITLE: Procedures
PROCEDURES.LEDE: What Gotchu does for each kind of request. Only a procedure can let it send on its own.
